name: neon-siege
description: Neon Siege — a browser-based 2D shooter with infinite wave survival and neon aesthetics

scripts.dev:server: npm run db:migrate:local --workspace=server && npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.dev:all: npm run db:migrate:local --workspace=server && concurrently -k -n client,worker,stripe -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "stripe listen --forward-to http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/credits/webhook"
scripts.dev:no-stripe: npm run db:migrate:local --workspace=server && concurrently -k -n client,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=server"
scripts.dev:all:infisical: npm run dev:sync-env && npm run dev:all
scripts.deploy:prod:all: concurrently -n worker,pages -c magenta,cyan "npm run deploy:prod:worker" "npm run deploy:prod:pages"

author: Diego Lamarão & Github Copilot
